658d64aa6792915fcaa0eb9efb6fbc38836e4853: A resort on a human scale, La Rosière focuses on the quality of its welcome and its closeness rather than on impressive figures. Its 65 km of runs are ideal for a stay of 3 to 4 days, especially with family or for skiers who do not need to constantly change their playground. La Rosière's family reputation is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, a well-run childcare service, well-maintained green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. With a summit at 2809 m and a village at 1850 m, snow reliability at La Rosière is generally dependable from January to the end of March. A few exceptionally mild winters can create tension early in the season, but conditions recover quickly with the first significant snowfalls. A stay in La Rosière is clearly expensive: a 55€ day lift pass, plus accommodation and high-altitude restaurants that are among the most expensive in the Alps. It is the price of excellence, but you should be aware of it before you go. In short, La Rosière keeps its promises. A Northern Alps resort that will suit the majority of skiers without disappointing.
